title: Deep-learning de novo GLP-1RAs show half-life about 3x semaglutide in mice
summary: 10,000 designed GLP-1RAs; 60 passed criteria; 62% in vitro success; two had half-lives about three times semaglutide and the best candidate outperformed semaglutide in diabetic and obesity mouse models. Preprint; mouse data only; head-to-head claims not independently checked; affiliations not read.
